title: Fish Divider
description: Fish Divider is an engaging underwater puzzle game where you must divide different schools of fish into their designated tanks. Each level presents a new challenge with various obstacles and tools at your disposal. Use your problem-solving skills to ensure each fish finds its rightful place.
